lines.text: Paul has not stopped giving thanks for them since hearing of their faith in the Lord Jesus and love for all the saints.
Paul prays the Father will give them a spirit of wisdom and revelation, so they may know the riches of His glorious grace in the saints.
God exerted His mighty strength in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand.
Christ is seated far above all rule, authority, power and dominion, in the present age and the one to come.
God put everything under Christ's feet and made Him head over everything for the church, which is His bride.
